proposal:
Here is the equivalent PostgreSQL `SELECT` statement with canonicalized formatting:

```sql
SELECT 
  SUM(realline) AS total_realized_pnl, 
  SUM(walletsum) AS total_account_balance, 
  (SUM(realline) / NULLIF(SUM(walletsum), 0)) AS profit_ratio 
FROM 
  accountbalances;
```

This query remains the same as it is already well-formatted and follows PostgreSQL conventions. The `NULLIF` function ensures division by zero is handled correctly.
